text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while reviewing my schedule…
choice_data_list: (I have room for a nice, long break this month…)
(I have room for a nice, long break this month…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Tosen Jordan is riding a tidal wave of momentum, having secured several wins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She no doubt deserves some rest, but I should be thinking about how to best take advantage of this…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dude, just take a break.
choice_data_list: Giving it to me straight, huh.
Giving it to me straight, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, if you can take time off then take it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, what's there to worry about anyway? We just have to both be off at the same time. Easy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Welp, here we are. Time to relax in the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, you won this trip yourself. You can't just not go.
choice_data_list: I thought you were gonna go with a friend…
I thought you were gonna go with a friend…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell you already? It'd be too awkward. I love all my friends too much to choose just one of them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But if you and me go together, everyone'll understand. I'll just tell them it was to loosen up my muscles for running or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I wanna get in the water right away. Let's hurry up and go inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… That was to die for.
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a nice time too.
Looks like you had a nice time too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Of course. We came all the way here, gotta make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, they have table tennis. Can you play, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha, then let's play. Loser has to buy juice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan approaches the table… and the match is on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack… Clack!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Where're you going?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hit the ball, aiming for the rightside edge of the table… opposite of Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Crap! Gotta get over there…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she is an Umamusume, after all. Tosen Jordan reacts quickly, reaching out with her right hand, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What the?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ball cracks open with a loud burst.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, man! I totally would've won if that worked!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, now I'm hot… I'm gonna get in the hot spring again.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Can I get you the juice after?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cool.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: By the way, no using your phone while I'm gone, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Because you're not supposed to be working.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anything else is fine. Play a game or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even afterwards, Tosen Jordan hangs out in my room instead of going back to her own.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wow, what even is this show? I don't know any of the actors. Hilarious. It's boring, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I guess it doesn't really matter, does it? As long as we have something to watch.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, doesn't this kinda feel like hanging out at your grandma's house on summer vacation?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, you just go 'cause you gotta, and it's not like there's anything fun to do, but somehow you still kinda have a good time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: In the moment, it's so boring you could cry tears of happiness when you get to go home.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But then, way later…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You remember how nice the breeze felt when you opened the screen doors at Grandma's house…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And then… you just get taken back to that day a million years ago when you visited.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I feel like… I dunno, like that day I spent there has always lived on here inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I think someday, that's how I'll remember today too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan opens the window. A warm, gentle breeze caresses my face.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You better remember it too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Tosen Jordan and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
